But in case you haven’t, we’re a high-end project management consultancy and tech developer with a focus on upgrading the way construction projects are delivered. It’s a transformative educational experience. We challenge you to be your best self in all aspects of life. There are many diverse and interesting challenges available. It’s up to you to guide yourself into whichever areas you’re most interested – we’ll enable it. ( Get to know us better by watching a few more of our videos. ) Core values for a good life A life of human flourishing is all about meaningful relationships and challenging yourself to create a positive impact, so our values reflect the four levels of relationships that each of us has: Grow yourself – your relationship with yourself Care about people – your relationship with others around you Execute to greatness – your relationship with your team Build civilisation – your relationship with humanity and the world We enshrined our values in our vision: We exist so that everyone in our team can flourish in a high-impact community that: Connects us with meaningful relationships Inspires us to develop ourselves to become better humans Empowers us to pursue our own learning adventures By first doing this, we can achieve the highest levels of value for the world. And enable the achievement of our vision through our two missions: To fully digitalise the construction of human civilisation To create a new type of organisation that enables human flourishing while delivering a huge positive impact on society _____________________________________________________________________ The Role Purpose of the role You will be enhancing the delivery of the most complex and interesting projects in the world through the power of project controls. You will be a senior leader in our team pushing the discipline to new heights not only within Laminar but within the industry in general. Your team This role is part of our Project Management Consultancy which focuses on: Understanding what the real problems of projects are. Implementing the best solutions to those problems. You must have: A construction engineering background: You have solid capability in the control of cost, schedule, and change, along with deep experience in developing project controls processes and reporting that align with strategic objectives and broader project context. Communication skills: You have the charisma, presence, and influence to engage construction teams, drive adoption of new approaches, and promote best practices across the board. Leadership capabilities: You’re a proven leader, coach, and developer of teams, capable of guiding others and building high-performing planning and controls functions. Impact: You have a strong track record of implementing scalable, repeatable solutions that created significant positive impact across complex projects. Laminar isn’t the place for you if any of the following is true: You want an easy, chilled-out role without much challenge You like to be the smartest person in the room You don’t like continuously receiving honest candid feedback You prefer to do your own thing rather than work with a team _____________________________________________________________________ Frequently Asked Questions What kinds of projects would I be working on? A tax-efficient way to get wheels – and do your bit for the environment The life-changing stuff: In-house coaching. As we grow, you grow. Our generous equity scheme is especially powerful for those who stay with us on our journey. You help us build the future – and own a piece of it Flexible working. Our goal is for every year here to be worth five years of development anywhere else. You’ll get a coach, a mentor, honest feedback, and a culture that challenges you to keep levelling up ____________________________________________________________ Important! After that, we’ll reach out to you to schedule a casual conversation to help you get to know us a bit better and tell us a bit about yourself. A couple of technical and personal assessments follow to understand your capability based on our own development matrix. This is to ensure that when you join, you’re starting at the right level of responsibility. Our services include, but are not limited to, business formation, accounting, tax, payroll, audit, and HR solutions, all delivered through a personalized, relationship-first approach. We partner with clients at every stage of their journey, helping them navigate the complexities of business and finance with confidence. Recognized as a Top 100 Small Business by the U.S. Chamber of Commerce and a Top 25 Small Business of the Year by the COBB Chamber for four consecutive years, we’re trusted by both local and international clients. Our CEO, Burcu Bree Manay, was also named one of the Top 50 Women in Accounting for her leadership and impact in the field. At Manay CPA, your growth is our purpose. Join a team where innovation, integrity, and global collaboration drive real success. 👉 Learn more at www.manaycpa.com We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and resourceful Executive Assistant to provide high-level support to our CEO and Partners. In this role, you will help manage executive priorities, coordinate key business activities, and ensure the smooth day-to-day operations of the leadership team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who thrives in a fast-paced international environment and wants to build a long-term career in executive operations and strategic support. We Offer USD-based salary based on experience Fully remote work anywhere in Turkey A collaborative culture with a strong sense of belonging Ongoing professional development and training Paid vacation and holidays Growth opportunities Requirements Bachelor's Degree in a relevant field 3–6 years of professional experience, including at least 2 years supporting executives or senior leaders Experience in executive assistance, administrative operations, office management, event coordination, or client-facing business support roles Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook Native/Bilingual in Turkish, excellent verbal and written communication skills in business English. All interviews will be conducted in English! Proactive problem-solving ability and strong attention to detail This is a full-time remote position based in Turkey A dedicated home office/workspace is required Flexibility to occasionally support executive needs outside standard business hours is expected Working hours will be aligned with U.S. Eastern Time (EST) Candidates based in Istanbul are preferred; however, applications from all locations within Türkiye are welcome. Responsibilities Manage complex executive calendars, appointments, meetings, and scheduling priorities Coordinate domestic and international travel, accommodations, itineraries, and logistics Prepare meeting agendas, presentations, reports, and executive correspondence Ensure meeting readiness by organizing materials, tracking action items, and following up on deliverables Serve as a key communication link between executives, clients, and internal stakeholders Manage executive email communications, LinkedIn accounts, and professional correspondence Maintain accurate records, contact databases, and CRM information Coordinate special projects, leadership initiatives, and administrative processes Prepare expense reports, documentation, and other confidential executive materials Support executives with personal administrative matters while ensuring the efficient coordination of day-to-day priorities. Your Security Matters! To protect yourself from recruitment scams, please note that all official Manay CPA recruitment communications will only come from email addresses ending in @manaycpa.com or @hire.lever.co . If you have any concerns or need assistance, please contact us at hr@manaycpa.com. As an international company, we kindly request that you add your English resume/CV to your application. Applicants who do not provide an English resume/CV may not be considered. Manay CPA provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training. You can reach our Applicant Data Protection Policy through this link: https://www.manaycpa.com/tr/hakkimizda/kariyer/calisan-adayi-kvkk/ We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

review_candidates.description: Descrição do Cargo o cargo de encarregado estrutura na congesa é responsável pela coordenação das equipes de montagem e execução de estruturas metálicas e de concreto em obras na região de indaiatuba sp. no dia a dia a pessoa neste cargo realiza o planejamento das frentes de trabalho acompanha a execução dos serviços garante o cumprimento de prazos e de padrões de qualidade e segurança. também distribui tarefas orienta profissionais de diferentes níveis verifica uso adequado de materiais e equipamentos e registra o andamento das atividades para alinhamento com a liderança da obra. este é um cargo full time com atuação presencial em campo e interface constante com engenheiros mestres de obras fornecedores e demais áreas envolvidas no projeto. Qualificações experiência prévia em estruturas metálicas ou de concreto em obras de construção civil incluindo leitura e interpretação de projetos e acompanhamento de cronograma físico. vivência em liderança de equipes operacionais com capacidade de organizar times de trabalho orientar profissionais e promover um ambiente seguro e colaborativo. conhecimento prático em normas de segurança do trabalho uso de epi e procedimentos para prevenção de acidentes em canteiro de obras. habilidade para se comunicar de forma clara com diferentes áreas registrando informações relevantes e repassando orientações técnicas de maneira objetiva. ensino médio completo sendo desejável curso técnico em construção civil edificações ou áreas correlatas além de experiência comprovada como encarregado ou líder de equipe em obras. será considerado diferencial conhecimento em medições de serviços uso básico de ferramentas digitais para registro de dados e disponibilidade para atuar em diferentes frentes de obra conforme necessidade da empresa.
